tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Returns the configurable watch models with base price (EUR incl. French VAT), diameter and a rendered picture of the default configuration.

tools.name: describe_model
tools.description: Components, options (option_id, name, surcharge_eur, is_default), mutual exclusions (exclusive_group) and dependencies (depends_on: the component only exists if one of these options is selected). option_id values are opaque identifiers; name is the label to use with the user.

tools.name: validate_configuration
tools.description: Resolves defaults, exclusions and dependencies; returns valid=false with errors (unknown_option, dependency_unmet) and warnings (exclusive_conflict) that can be fixed, plus the resolved list of selections and total EUR price.

tools.name: quote_configuration
tools.description: Price in the billing currency of the DELIVERY country (the currency cannot be chosen), with the tax regime: French VAT inside the EU, 0% VAT outside the EU (duties payable by the buyer). Indicative and non-binding; the checkout on brm-chronographes.com is authoritative.

tools.name: render_configuration
tools.description: Composes the photographic rendering of the configured watch (JPEG). view 0 is the three-quarter view; 30 views (0-29) rotate the watch by 12° each.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Returns configurator_url (opens this exact watch in the configurator on brm-chronographes.com, where the user can adjust it and add it to the basket; this is the link meant for the user) and preview_url (a public presentation page with rotation, shared by every identical configuration). Idempotent.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Sends the user's request to the B.R.M team: 'appointment' (private visit of the manufacture — a booking link is returned), 'quote' (personalised quote by email), or 'special_request' (anything the configurator does not offer; the workshop checks feasibility). Requires the user's explicit agreement t

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Prepares an order of this configured watch for the user. ONLY call it when the user explicitly asked you to order it and agreed to share their name, email and delivery address with B.R.M (user_consent=true). B.R.M then emails the user a summary with a 'Confirm my order' button; the order is placed O

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Returns only the state of the order: awaiting_customer_confirmation, confirming, confirmed_awaiting_payment, paid, expired, cancelled, confirmation_email_failed or needs_assistance. No customer data. Pass the order_id returned by create_order, or the idempotency_key you used.
